safety.title: This is unverified reference information, not advice.
safety.body: Conditions change — erosion, tree growth and seasonal snow can turn a once-jumpable exit lethal within months. Every measurement carries its date; check how old it is, and verify everything yourself.

panelUnavailable.title: Contribution isn't open yet
panelUnavailable.body: The submission panel isn't live. OpenExits is published and the standard is finished, but the service that accepts new exit sites and puts them through human review hasn't been deployed yet.
panelUnavailable.meanwhile: The specification, the validator and the commons are all public and usable today. If you want to contribute a site now, the repository accepts it directly.
